summary.text: Nicole Locklin is the Democratic nominee in Florida's 26th District. An attorney who grew up in a small Oklahoma town, she worked in litigation and then as in-house counsel at technology companies. Her campaign focuses on affordability and anti-corruption measures.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in a small Oklahoma town and graduated from Pond Creek-Hunter High School; says she was the first in her family to graduate from college.
Earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma (2009) and a law degree from Santa Clara University School of Law (2015).
Worked for more than a decade as an attorney in litigation, technology, healthcare, privacy and artificial-intelligence law.

According to BallotReady, was a litigation associate and then senior associate at Lerch Sturmer LLP (2016-2020), commercial counsel at Nextdoor (2020-2022), and lead legal counsel at Databricks (2022-2026).
Became the Democratic nominee after the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat was canceled.
